parameters.jsonBody:
={
  "composition": "PetPortraitTransform",
  "inputProps": {
    "originalImageUrl": "{{ $json.imageUrl }}",
    "breed": "{{ $json.breed }}",
    "style": "{{ $json.style }}",
    "audioUrl": "{{ $json.audio.url }}",
    "ctaText": "Link in bio - $9",
    "overlayText": "POV: Your {{ $json.breed }} becomes a {{ $json.style }} painting"
  },
  "codec": "h264",
  "imageFormat": "jpeg",
  "fps": 30,
  "height": 1920,
  "width": 1080,
  "durationInFrames": 450
}

nodes.name: Remotion: Render Video
nodes.notes: Requires Remotion template at remotion.dev with composition 'PetPortraitTransform'. Template should: show original photo (left) → morphing transition → AI portrait (right) → end card with CTA. 15 seconds (450 frames @ 30fps).
